content:
CNN’s Kasie Hunt on Monday appeared to have a rather amused reaction to Donald Trump’s closing message on the eve of the 2026 midterm elections, and reached for an iconic line from the hit rom-com “Notting Hill” to sum it all up.

The “Arena” anchor cast a mocking eye over the president’s speech at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, where he devoted a large chunk of his address to boasting about his renovations in the capital.

“Did you catch the midterm message there?” Hunt asked after airing footage of Trump’s remarks. “Because the president of the United States of America spent the first 22 minutes of his closing speech the day before Election Day talking about a massive piece of pool and grass and pipes and columns.”

Hunt then aired a clip of Trump saying that if “just a good portion” of his previous voters vote, then the GOP will “win in a landslide,” yet acknowledging that the sitting president’s party typically struggles in midterm elections “but we gave this a very strong shot.”

“Well, there’s the closing message, ‘We gave it a shot,’” Hunt deadpanned.

She also noted that Trump delivered his remarks before a relatively sparse crowd.

“Trump was not in a battleground state alongside a Senate candidate. He was not at a big, energetic MAGA rally,” she said.

“Instead, it was just a man, he’s in there somewhere, standing in front of a pool, asking you to love it,” she concluded, echoing Julia Roberts’ iconic movie line.
